# url-metadata-social-fetcher
Canonical repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/url-metadata-social-fetcher
Release: 1.0.0.1
Author: Vincenzo Picciuolo, HRN Innovation Technologies Ltd
License: MIT

Purpose: SSRF-safe public URL fetching, Open Graph/SEO metadata, JSON-LD, social-link discovery, social profile enrichment, oEmbed, canonical URL normalization and image mirroring.
Primary API: enrichUrl(input, options)
Security API: assertSafeUrl, isSafeUrl, safeFetch
Metadata API: enrichPage, extractMetadata, extractJsonLd, extractText, extractSocialLinks
Social API: detectNetwork, enrichSocialProfile, enrichSocialProfiles, fetchOEmbed
Storage API: mirrorImage, mirrorImages, createFileSystemTarget, createHttpPutTarget
Use cases: link previews, URL unfurling, startup directories, creator profiles, marketplaces, Outbid-style rankings, product directories, CRM enrichment, SEO tools and AI/RAG URL ingestion.
Production reference: https://behot.now/get-hot
